response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A6.1", "A6.2"], "rationale": "The claim involves a fracture of the distal radius confirmed by a medical report, which falls under the coverage for fractures under the accident section. There is no indication in the evidence that the injury was caused by alcohol, intentional action, war, terrorism, or extreme sports (A11.1, A11.2, A11.3, A11.4), and the product includes coverage for extreme sports, so A11.3 does not apply here."}
